decisions.reason: As a close-to-core service offer launched only recently, management is likely to continue it for now, although the relatively low public commitment on the website makes it somewhat easier to withdraw than more prominently promoted products.

The seventy-two-hour express program fits the firm's service-oriented strategy, but because it was only mentioned on the website and may be demanding to deliver operationally, it has the highest withdrawal risk among the new offers while still being likely retained in the short run.

This fire-resistant steel exterior door was launched very visibly on the home page, is certified, and sits directly in the firm's core technical and compliance-heavy business, which strongly favors continued commitment.
An express delivery program for doors and gates matches the firm's established offer and was given its own page, so the visible commitment and strategic fit make management likely to keep it.

The online ordering and digital services platform was presented on its own page and supports the firm's stated move toward deeper advisory and service support, so management is likely to persist with it.

A fire and smoke protection door is close to the firm's core safety-focused product line, and despite only modest website visibility, the firm is likely to keep it because it reinforces its established market position and recent launch decisions.
